title: fix(plugin-audit)!: a row about a record is served only when the reader can open that record through the data door
body:
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no published skill names the parent-record read gates or which rows they serve

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：活动流、审计日志（未持有审计豁免能力的读者）、评论三处，只有当读者能通过数据接口打开所属记录时才返回该行；数据接口对所有人都不开放的对象（如 OAuth 资源、连接器凭据），其相关行不再返回给任何人，管理员也不例外。
- 为什么改：三处的规则与数据接口统一：一行关于某条记录的数据，只在读者能通过数据接口打开那条记录时返回；三处与数据接口用同一个判断。
- 风险与回滚：组织管理员不再在审计日志里看到这类对象的行（包括自己 OAuth 授权的使用记录），需要的话显式授予 view_all_audit_log 即可；平台管理员不受影响。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/parent-record-read-gate.ts（enumerateParentObjects 与整读探针的 byObject 循环）、comment-access-hooks.ts（未盖章线程探针）、audit-log-read-visibility.ts（头注释）。
- 两分钟验证：pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit exec vitest run src/parent-record-read-admission.integration.test.ts，预期新 describe「a parent the data door does not serve」全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地

## What changes

A row about a record (an activity row, a compliance-ledger row for a reader the ledger gate narrows, a comment) is served to a reader only when the reader can open that record through the data door. The shared parent-record gate now leaves out every parent object whose `enable` block the data door refuses `get` for, judged by the door's own decision, `canServeApiOperation(enable, 'get')` from `@objectstack/spec/data`. That decision depends on the declaration alone, so it holds for every reader, administrators included.

- `parent-record-read-gate.ts`: applied in `enumerateParentObjects`, so no leaf is written for such a parent, and in the whole-read probe, which keeps no row naming one. With no registry view, the whole-read probe cannot say what the door serves: it keeps no row (fail closed) and says so once.
- `comment-access-hooks.ts`: the same predicate in the unstamped-thread probe, so the comment rule holds on rows the parent-pair backfill has not reached.
- `activity-field-redaction.ts` is unchanged. It reads the gate's own enumeration, so its WHERE carries no branch for such a parent; the rows served are the same, since the gate excludes them.
- Not touched: `canReadObject`, the engine's leaf, `packages/rest`, `packages/spec`, and every object's `enable`. Internal reads, system reads and `current_user.can()` keep their answers.
- Module headers (gate, activity, ledger, comments, credential-use writer) now state the rule. In the ledger, a parent the data door serves to no one counts as a record the reader cannot open. A credential-use row about such a parent is read through the ledger's audit capability.

Who moves:

- **Activity stream**: every reader, administrators included, stops being served rows about records of an object the data door does not serve.
- **Compliance ledger**: readers the gate narrows, organization administrators included, stop being served those rows. That includes their own OAuth consent-use rows; the auth door's authorized-clients view still shows each client's last use. An explicit `view_all_audit_log` grant gives them back. Holders of that capability are decided first and stay whole.
- **Comments**: no reader is served a comment on such a record.

The scope (all three gates, administrators included) was confirmed by the maintainer.

## Tests

- `parent-record-read-admission.integration.test.ts`: new top-level describe "a parent the data door does not serve". It uses a real engine and a real driver, with rows written by the real CRUD mirror. It covers the leaf path and the whole-read probe path, and for each gate (activity, ledger, comments) a member's list, count, aggregate and `findOne`. A non-vacuity control (system count of at least 1) runs first. It adds an administrator case, a CONTROL that a holder of the audit capability still reads every ledger row, and CONTROLs that a parent the door serves and one with no `enable` block keep their rows.
- Unit cases in `activity-read-visibility.test.ts`, `audit-log-read-visibility.test.ts`, `comment-read-visibility.test.ts` and `comment-thread-leaf.test.ts`: the leaf path, the whole-read probe, a list-only object, and the no-registry fail-closed path with its once-only warning. The whole-read-probe fixtures of those files gain a registry view holding the parents they declare, because the fail-closed rule now needs one.
- Dogfood `activity-parent-read-gate.dogfood.test.ts`: a system-context write to `sys_oauth_resource`. Neither the member nor the administrator is served its activity row, by list or by id.

## Acceptance notes

- The whole-read probe used to read every row's parent. It now keeps only parents the registry holds and the door serves. A row about an object no registry holds was already excluded by the leaf path; it is now excluded on the probe path too.
